issues.message: No authenticated user turn was bound to this tool call, so no action can be authorized. Trust is derived from OpenClaw host provenance (message_received / llm_input / before_tool_call), never from the task graph.
Action 'desktop_folder_create_explicit' belongs to disabled capability tier 'desktop_direct_write'.
An action requires a trusted user or policy instruction source.
A direct trusted_user instruction must explicitly name the operation and exact target.
